summary: decision D01: P06 rescope: spec internalization + dogfood instead of plan §4 'Hardening + GA'

payload.summary: P06 rescope: spec internalization + dogfood instead of plan §4 'Hardening + GA'
payload.rationale: Plan §4 lists P06 as Hardening + GA (Linux polish, golden scenarios, release tag). Phase 6 reframed to (a) internalize the v0.1 design spec into docs/, (b) dogfood eawf on its own repo, (c) ship the v0.1 PR. The displaced hardening work is captured in v0.2 backlog items B001 (Linux CI matrix), B009 (golden scenarios), B010 (v0.1.0 release tag).
alternatives: Keep plan §4 P06 scope verbatim; defer spec internalization to v0.1.1

summary: decision D02: B019 audit-check DSL: yaml declarative + check-kind registry

payload.summary: B019 audit-check DSL: yaml declarative + check-kind registry
payload.rationale: Bottleneck is non-coders authoring audits, not expressing arbitrary logic. YAML + registry of built-in kinds (file_exists, regex_match, json_path_value, pytest_pass, coverage_min, numeric_threshold, command_exit_zero) lets check-authors stay in YAML; new kinds are a code change. Hybrid escape hatch can come later if real example pushes against the registry.
alternatives: python-callable-only (every check needs a code change)

summary: decision D03: B020 hypothesis lifecycle: audit-link required at set-verdict only

payload.summary: B020 hypothesis lifecycle: audit-link required at set-verdict only
payload.rationale: Audit link gates the commitment, not the exploration. Forcing audit at hypothesis open time forces premature audit design; making it fully optional fails the verify-before-claim rule. Permissive open + required audit on set-verdict matches the dogfood workflow.
alternatives: audit link required at hypothesis open time

summary: decision D04: B021 artifact registry: sha256 mandatory for files, optional for URLs

payload.summary: B021 artifact registry: sha256 mandatory for files, optional for URLs
payload.rationale: Local file integrity is cheap to enforce; URL integrity is a different problem (provenance + fetch policy). Mandatory-everywhere couples the registry to network state at registration. eawf artifact verify recomputes on demand for both cases.

summary: decision D05: B022 integrity runner: auto on phase close + opt-in eawf validate --integrity

payload.summary: B022 integrity runner: auto on phase close + opt-in eawf validate --integrity
payload.rationale: Phase close is the natural integrity boundary; manual run is the escape hatch for debugging. Every-mutation is too slow on hot paths like wave dispatch; manual-only is easy to forget. Failures block phase close; --force requires audit reason so the bypass is recorded.

summary: decision D06: Defer retro audit-verdict + backlog priority-bumps to P07 CLI completeness

payload.summary: Defer retro audit-verdict + backlog priority-bumps to P07 CLI completeness
payload.rationale: v0.1 CLI lacks 'eawf audit set-verdict' and 'eawf backlog set-priority' verbs. Hand-editing state.json would violate AGENTS.md rule 4 (state CLI is the only mutator). Safer to ship the verbs in P07 and do the retro-stamping (A01..A06 verdicts; B015/B017 P2->P1) at P07 closeout in one pass.
alternatives: ship the verbs as a P06 follow-up commit before tagging v0.1.0

summary: decision D07: PR merge strategy: rebase-and-merge; never squash, never merge-commit

payload.summary: PR merge strategy: rebase-and-merge; never squash, never merge-commit
payload.rationale: Squash collapses per-wave/per-commit history into a single fat commit on main, losing the symbol-prefixed audit trail (e.g. [P06-W05] [P06-CORE]) that AGENTS.md commit-prefix rule and the wave/audit chain depend on for reconstructibility from git log. Rebase-merge preserves linear, individual commits with their original messages — matches the cherry-pick discipline that already feeds the long-running phase branch. Merge-commits forbidden by repo settings (mergeCommitAllowed=false). Default for all phase PRs unless explicitly overridden.
alternatives: squash-merge (collapses history; rejected — incident 2026-05-10 PR #3 squashed by ship skill, reverted via force-push, redone as rebase-merge in PR #4)

summary: decision D08: Defer PR-cadence policy change until v0.2.0 ship

payload.summary: Defer PR-cadence policy change until v0.2.0 ship
payload.rationale: User proposed shifting from per-phase PR to review-driven + version-bump PR mid-v0.2. Mid-stream workflow change = state-of-record drift risk; defer re-evaluation to v0.2.0 cut, when iter/phase aggregation pattern is fully exercised.
alternatives: Adopt review-driven PR cadence immediately (rejected: mid-game policy churn)
Lock per-phase PR forever (rejected: pre-decides v0.2.0 retro)
